$comment: Where `kun compile` writes each agent's NATIVE config. One entry per agent (home dir) with a target per source kind: instructions (CLAUDE.md template + rules-global), skills (.claude/skills), agents (.claude/agents), commands (skills exposed as slash commands), mcp (.claude/mcp.json), hooks, model (engine.json), memory (the org-memory pointer appended to every instructions file). `path` uses ~ for the home dir (tests swap the home via KUN_COMPILE_HOME); `transform` names the function in scripts/compile/<agent>.mjs (exports `transforms`); `null` path = the agent has no such surface, so nothing is written. Merges keep every key/section kun does not own (secrets, auth, channels, personal settings); a hand-made file is backed up to ~/.kun/backup/<agent>/<timestamp>/ before its first overwrite; generated files carry «generated by kun compile — edit kun, not this file» where the format allows a comment. Run: `kun compile --all|--only a,b [--check|--dry-run|--quiet]`; hermes is dry-run unless `--only hermes --write`.

claude.$comment: Claude Code. setup.sh IS the installer (agents, rules, skills, hooks, bin, MCP registration); this adapter wraps it (--check = installed vs source, fix = setup.sh --quiet) and owns one marked block in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

instructions.$comment: only the marked memory-pointer block; the file is the teammate's own

mcp.$comment: registered by setup.sh via `claude mcp add-json`

fcc.$comment: Free Claude Code (`f` lane, kun-free.sh → OmniRoute/Nous). Shares ~/.claude through symlinks, so it is verified, not translated. Fix = kun-free.sh --setup.

model.$comment: the lane's own settings.json (model + provider env from kun-free.sh)

codex.$comment: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.17x. Custom agents are ~/.codex/agents/<name>.toml; skills are ~/.codex/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (.system is Codex's own). MCP lives in config.toml as [mcp_servers.<name>] — kun's go in one marked block; model/auth/plugins untouched.

commands.$comment: Codex custom prompts are deprecated in favour of skills

model.$comment: Codex runs OpenAI models; the Claude model chain does not apply

opencode.$comment: opencode 1.x. opencode.json keys mcp/agent/command/instructions are merged by name (kun-owned names tracked in ~/.kun/compile/opencode.json); permission, model, provider are preserved.

agents.$comment: prompt files; entries go in opencode.json `agent` (mode subagent; no model — Claude aliases do not map)

model.$comment: free-model routing is the provider/omniroute block, hand-made and preserved

agy.$comment: Antigravity / Gemini CLI. Port of antigravity-sync.sh: same MCP transform (remote → serverUrl), same symlinks, same doctrine copy, plus the repo-side .agents/skills mirror.

hooks.$comment: pre-existing link to ~/.claude/hooks; not managed here

hermes.$comment: Hermes chat gateway. Only non-secret parts: SOUL.md (template .claude/hermes/SOUL.md) and cron jobs (.claude/hermes/jobs.json merged by name). config.yaml, auth.json, channels are never written. Default dry-run; real writes need `--only hermes --write`.

skills.$comment: config.yaml skills.* is hand-owned (credentials live there)
